subject.title: fix(plugins): run message_sending on all channel agent-reply deliveries (#92374)

question: Should this PR keep the Telegram delivery-owned `message_sending` opt-out after fixing suffix re-entry, or should the streamed-final work be split from the dispatcher fix?
rationale: The remaining blocker is both a concrete bug and a shared safety-hook ownership decision; green tests alone cannot decide whether maintainers want this internal hook boundary shape.

options.title: Fix suffix re-entry in this PR
options.body: Keep the combined dispatcher and Telegram streamed-final repair, but send already-gated suffix chunks through a path that skips `message_sending` and add full-dispatch coverage for pass-through and rewrite long finals.

options.title: Accept per-suffix gating deliberately
options.body: Maintainers could accept duplicate suffix gating only if the PR drops the exactly-once claim and documents the visible cancel/rewrite semantics for long streamed replies.

options.title: Split dispatcher from streaming
options.body: Land or replace with a narrower dispatcher-only fix while leaving Telegram streamed-final gating to the canonical issue until the ownership boundary is settled.

recommendation.title: Fix suffix re-entry in this PR
recommendation.body: Keep the combined dispatcher and Telegram streamed-final repair, but send already-gated suffix chunks through a path that skips `message_sending` and add full-dispatch coverage for pass-through and rewrite long finals.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the broadest recent history across the plugin/channel boundary files and is a good routing candidate for the shared hook-boundary decision.
